snippet.title: Ghost Keeper | Official Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
✅  Add Ghost Keeper to your Steam Wishlist 👉  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/
✅  Join official Discord server 👉  https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m

The ultimate scaring experience is about to begin! Become the leader of a terrifying band of monsters and challenge the living. It’s time to witness the excitement of scaring like never before…


Features:

💀  Take control of ghosts, demons, and monsters, use their unique abilities and/to defeat your enemies
💀  Fight malicious Brotherhood, show the world who is the ultimate keeper of fearful creatures
💀  Exploit varied strategies, there is never only one path to victory - the way you lead is entirely up to you
💀  Enjoy a truly grotesque approach, witness a host of bizarre situations narrated by the peculiar, malicious narrator
💀  Marvel at the Victorian era setting, locations, style and atmosphere that’ll captivate you on each subsequent level


Follow Ghost Keeper at: 

Twitter/x - https://x.com/GhostKeeperGame
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@ghostkeepergame
Discord - https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m


#gaming #teaser #gamedev #ghost
